NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION

Northgate Advantage has completed review of the above inpatient admission. Based on the clinical information submitted, an adverse determination, medical necessity has been issued for the inpatient admission billed under DRG 192 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].

Basis for Determination

The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

The review was conducted using the MCG-style criteria set in effect for the service period. The following criteria were found not met:

COPD-01: Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-02: Symptoms improved with emergency department treatment.

No other criteria codes were applied in this determination.

Claim Adjustment Information

The following codes apply to this claim: CARC CO-50; RARC N115.

Appeal Rights and Instructions

A reconsideration request may be submitted within the applicable filing window. Any clinical rationale submitted in support of reconsideration must map each finding to a numbered criterion as cited above. Submissions that do not identify the specific numbered criterion for each clinical finding may be returned without substantive review.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that date will be closed as untimely.

Supporting documentation for reconsideration should include the complete admission record, physician orders, and any progress notes covering [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]], referenced to criteria COPD-01 and COPD-02.

This adverse determination, medical necessity addresses medical necessity of the inpatient admission only and does not constitute a statement regarding the member's benefit eligibility or other coverage provisions of the plan. Questions regarding this notice may be directed to the Utilization Management Department using the contact information printed on the member identification card.

A physician reviewer is available to discuss this adverse determination, medical necessity with the attending provider upon request.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
